body:
## Summary

Resolves #1111 — adds a **Enemies Table** view in the Experimental menu, analogous to the existing Unlock Table.

The table shows which unique enemy types appear on each map, with per-type counts:

| Map | Rifle | Shotgun | UZI | Machete | PKM |
|-----|-------|---------|-----|---------|-----|
| Labyrinth | 4 | 1 | — | — | — |
| Building | 9 | — | 1 | — | — |
| Castle | 2 | 3 | 8 | — | — |
| Beach | 2 | 1 | — | 5 | — |
| Docks | 9 | 3 | 6 | 2 | — |
| Labyrinth 2 | 10 | 2 | 2 | — | 1 |
| City | 5 | 2 | 2 | — | — |
| Decadence | 7 | 2 | — | 3 | — |
| Polygon | 10 | — | — | — | — |
| Double Corridor | 13 | — | — | — | — |
| Factory | 13 | — | — | — | — |

## Changes

- **`scripts/ui/enemies_table_menu.gd`** — new `CanvasLayer` menu built programmatically, following the `UnlockTableMenu` pattern; color-coded columns per enemy type (Rifle=blue, Shotgun=orange, UZI=green, Machete=red, PKM=gold); zeroes shown as `—`
- **`scenes/ui/EnemiesTableMenu.tscn`** — minimal scene wiring the script (same structure as `UnlockTableMenu.tscn`)
- **`scripts/ui/experimental_menu.gd`** — added `@onready` ref, `preload`, signal connections, and `_on_enemies_table_pressed` / `_on_enemies_table_back_pressed` handlers following the unlock table pattern exactly
- **`scenes/ui/ExperimentalMenu.tscn`** — added `EnemiesTableContainer` row (label + "Open" button + description) with separator, placed between the unlock table and enemy spawner sections

## Test plan

- [ ] Open Experimental menu in-game
- [ ] Click "Open" next to "View Enemies Table" — table overlay appears
- [ ] Verify all 11 maps are listed with correct enemy type counts
- [ ] Verify color-coding: Rifle=blue, Shotgun=orange, UZI=green, Machete=red, PKM=gold
- [ ] Verify zero-count cells show `—` instead of `0`
- [ ] Click "Back" — overlay hides, experimental menu remains visible
- [ ] Re-open — table shows again without error
